grass_dirt.rule: a path cell's corner is grass when any cell sharing that corner on the same level is grass

grass_sand.rule: as grass_dirt (decision 44; not in the TileSet, whose terrain sets keep dirt and paving)

shore.key: bit 1 N, 2 E, 4 S, 8 W = the neighbour is not water

overlays.ao_n: floor at the foot of a face
overlays.cheek_e: the east cheek of a flight of stairs
overlays.cheek_w: the west cheek of a flight of stairs
overlays.end_e: a face's east end, turning a corner
overlays.end_w: a face's west end, turning a corner
overlays.face_ao: the foot of a face that meets a floor
overlays.rim_e: top whose east neighbour is lower
overlays.rim_n: top whose north neighbour is lower
overlays.rim_w: top whose west neighbour is lower
overlays.shade_w: floor whose west neighbour is higher
